summary: InflaRx N.V. filed Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, attaching a press release and corporate presentation announcing advancement of its drug candidate izicopan in ANCA-associated vasculitis and select renal diseases. The filing describes development plans, including Phase 2 planning and open-label studies, and notes sufficient funding through 2029. There are no terms related to mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. This is a routine business update regarding clinical development and is not a special situation.
